items.headline: RBI Hikes Repo Rate by 25 Bps to 5.50%, Shifts Stance to 'Calibrated Tightening'
items.summary: The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) increased the repo rate by 25 basis points to 5.50% on October 7, 2026, marking its first hike since February 2023. This move was driven by persistent inflation and global tensions, with the MPC shifting its stance, signaling no near-term rate cuts.

items.headline: Inflationary Pressures Persist Amidst Volatile Crude Oil Prices and Monsoon Deficit
items.summary: Inflation remains a key concern, primarily due to global crude oil price volatility and the impact of a deficient southwest monsoon. US PCE inflation also rose, fueling expectations of a potential US Fed rate hike.

items.headline: Mixed Global Cues and Asian Sell-off Weigh on Markets
items.summary: Global markets showed mixed to negative cues, with S&P 500 futures, Japan's Topix, and Euro Stoxx 50 futures declining. Asian equities, especially tech and semiconductor stocks, experienced a sell-off due to AI investment concerns and disappointing US tech earnings.

items.headline: Elevated Crude Oil Prices Above $116 Per Barrel Pose Macroeconomic Headwind for India
items.summary: Brent crude prices remained elevated, trading above $116-$117 per barrel due to supply concerns and worsening geopolitical tensions in the Middle East, presenting a significant challenge for India's oil import dependence.

items.headline: Coal India Misses Profit Expectations Despite 57% Jump in Profit After Tax
items.summary: Coal India (COALINDIA.NS) reported a 57% jump in profit after tax to ₹6,547 crore but missed overall profit expectations due to higher costs.

items.headline: Trent Q2 Profit Jumps 23% Year-on-Year on Strong Apparel Sales, Shares Rally
items.summary: Trent (TRENT.NS) saw its Q2 profit jump 23% year-on-year, supported by strong apparel sales, leading to a rally in its shares.

items.headline: Laurus Labs Net Profit Surges 126.7% in Q2 FY27, Revenue Grows 33.4%
items.summary: Laurus Labs (LAURUSLABS.NS) reported a significant surge in net profit by 126.7% to ₹442 crore, with revenue growing 33.4%, causing its share price to rise.

items.headline: Suzlon Energy Shares Drop Over 8% After Q2 Results Disappoint on Margins
items.summary: Suzlon Energy (SUZLON.NS) saw its share price fall over 8% after its Q2 results, despite 26% revenue growth, as margins disappointed investors.

items.headline: IT Sector Emerges as Top Gainer as Nifty IT Index Surges 1.54%
items.summary: The IT sector was the top performer, with the Nifty IT index surging 1.54-2.17%. Leading gainers included Infosys, Wipro, Tech Mahindra, and HCLTech, seen as defensive beneficiaries amidst global AI investment concerns.

items.headline: Broader Markets Under Pressure as Nifty Midcap and Smallcap Indices Decline
items.summary: Broader markets, including the Nifty Midcap 100 and Nifty Smallcap 100, struggled with declines. The BSE Capital Goods sector was the worst performer.

items.headline: Sagility Limited Shares Decline Following Promoter's Block Deal to Offload 12% Stake
items.summary: Sagility Limited (SAGILITY.NS) shares declined after its promoter, Sagility B.V., reportedly initiated a block deal to offload a 12% stake in the company.

items.headline: Equitas Small Finance Bank Shares Tank as MD and CEO Resigns
items.summary: Equitas Small Finance Bank (EQUITASBNK.NS) shares tanked following the resignation of its MD and CEO, P N Vasudevan, amid investor concerns over a perceived conflict of interest.

items.headline: Reliance Industries Q2 FY27 Results Awaited, Focus on Refining Business Recovery
items.summary: Reliance Industries (RELIANCE.NS) is set to announce its Q2 FY27 results today, with investors keenly anticipating a recovery in its refining business.

content.outlook: Indian equities showed resilience yesterday with NIFTY 50 and SENSEX closing positive, primarily driven by strong performance in IT and Pharma sectors. However, weakness was observed in banking, energy, and auto stocks, with FIIs registering net selling activity. Traders should watch sector-specific momentum and institutional flows at the open.
keyTakeaways: NIFTY 50 (+0.51%) and SENSEX (+0.37%) closed higher, led by IT (+2.43%) and Pharma (+1.80%) sectors.
NIFTY BANK (-0.37%), NIFTY ENERGY (-1.03%) and NIFTY AUTO (-0.52%) were among the laggards.
WIPRO.NS (+3.7%) and SUNPHARMA.NS (+2.9%) were top gainers, while INDUSINDBK.NS (-3.0%) and ADANIPORTS.NS (-2.0%) were top losers.
FIIs recorded net selling of 944cr, largely offset by DII buying of 1924cr.
Market breadth was positive with 34 advances against 24 declines, and India VIX at 15.305.
